diff --git a/orgos/agile/flow_metric.py b/orgos/agile/flow_metric.py
index a6dc351..9a6b0cb 100644
--- a/orgos/agile/flow_metric.py
+++ b/orgos/agile/flow_metric.py
@@ -19,6 +19,20 @@ def takt_time(duration_seconds: float, n_issues: int) -> float:
     """Average calendar time per issue. Lower = faster flow.
 
     Returns 0.0 if no issues were processed (degenerate sprint).
+
+    Args:
+        duration_seconds: Total sprint duration in seconds.
+        n_issues: Number of issues completed in the sprint.
+
+    Returns:
+        Takt time in seconds per issue, or 0.0 if n_issues is zero
+        or negative.
+
+    Example:
+        >>> takt_time(3600.0, 4)
+        900.0
+        >>> takt_time(3600.0, 0)
+        0.0
     """
     if n_issues <= 0:
         return 0.0
